title: Pregnant Duo #45
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: German, in her early 20s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, wavy hair, real pores, real living eyes, 8 studs piercings set with opals in brass-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum a ring. Painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer, glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide mother-of-pearl bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of dense scrollwork wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both arms raised overhead framing her silhouette, belly and bust both fully displayed, confident direct gaze, extreme mother-of-pearl extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Emirati, in her mid 20s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, twin-tail hair, real pores, real living eyes, 8 clicker rings piercings set with amethysts in bronze-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal a bracelet. Painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic, a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide cobalt bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of floral medallion border wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, extreme cobalt extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
